entry.name: nodes
entry.description: The nodes object displays overlapping circular regions ("nodes") and outputs a list of interpolated weights based on the distance between a slider position and each node's center point. You can drag the slider with the mouse or set its position with a list of coordinates.

messages.name: (mouse)
messages.description: You can manipulate the nodes or the slider depending on theandattributes.

messages.name: active
messages.description: Sets the active state (0 disabled, 1 enabled) of the node(s). Index numbering for the nodes starts at 1. When the index is set to 0, it affects every node.

messages.name: ad
messages.digest: Set the position of the slider
messages.description: Sets the position of the slider (if present) in polar coordinates (azimuth in degrees, distance) and outputs the new coefficients.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: Outputs the nodes values out the second outlet.

messages.name: getactive
messages.description: The wordcauses theobject to send a list of the active states of every node out theoutlet. An optional argument allows you to query the active state of a specific node.

messages.name: getad
messages.description: The wordcauses theobject to send a list of polar coordinates of the slider out theoutlet.

messages.name: getnode
messages.description: The wordcauses theobject to send a list of the values of the node {x, y, size, active} of every node out theoutlet. An optional argument allows you to query a specific node.

messages.name: getsize
messages.description: The wordcauses theobject to send a list of the values of the node size of every node out theoutlet. An optional argument allows you to query a specific node.

messages.name: getxy
messages.description: The wordcauses theobject to send a list of cartesian coordinates of the slider out theoutlet.

messages.name: list
messages.digest: Set the position of the slider
messages.description: Sets the position of the slider (if present) and outputs the new coefficients.

messages.name: setnode
messages.digest: Sets the position of a node
messages.description: Sets the position of the node(s). Index numbering for the nodes starts at 1. When the index is set to 0, it affects every node. You can also provide additional arguments to define the size and active state.

messages.name: setnodead
messages.digest: Sets the position of a node
messages.description: Sets the position of the node(s) in azimuth (angle in degree) and distance. Index numbering for the nodes starts at 1. When the index is set to 0, it affects every node. You can also provide additional arguments to define the size and active state.

messages.name: setnodename
messages.digest: Sets the display name for a given node
messages.description: Sending the messagefollowed by an integer and a symbol changes the displayed name for that node from its index value to the specified symbol.

messages.name: setsize
messages.digest: Set the size of a node
messages.description: Sets the size of the specified node. Index numbering for the nodes starts at 1. When the index is set to 0, it affects every node.

inlets.digest: list of 2 (0.-1.) floats gives x,y for interpolation

outlets.digest: Interpolated weights for each active node
